strategy.lever: long length + search-demand topic (hours per view and per impression)
strategy.action: flood-ends-long (Genesis 8-9) 15-20 min with 'Why...' question title, Genesis chapters in title, KJV; then one such long per story/arc as capacity allows
strategy.evidence: in-niche (measured, vidIQ 11-02): a 3.9K-sub channel's 20.6 min 'Why God Cast Adam & Eve Out...' got 35.5K views (198x); our prayer longs: 4.3 min average per view (estimate 27.8 h / 385 views)
strategy.expected_effect: estimate: 1 long at 10 min average x 1,000 views = ~167 h; first test of the demand
strategy.metric: 7-day views and average view duration of flood-ends-long
strategy.success_threshold: >=300 views and >=6 min average within 7 d
strategy.kill_threshold: <100 views or <3 min average within 7 d -> revisit packaging before making more

strategy.action: pinned comment + description link of each Short and each cut to flood-ends-long; cuts end on an open loop ('what happened after the flood?') and set related video; Short slots only after the long is public
strategy.evidence: measured: 0 of 10 longs received any view from Shorts (daily report funnel table)
strategy.expected_effect: estimate: if 1% of ~2,000 Short views/week click, +20 long views/week
strategy.metric: views of the long with source Shorts / related video
strategy.success_threshold: >=20 long views from Shorts in 7 d
strategy.kill_threshold: 0 in 7 d -> move the link to end screens/playlist only

strategy.action: title A 'Why Did God Send the Rainbow After the Flood? | Noah's Ark Ends | Genesis 8-9 Bible Story (KJV)'; B 'After 150 Days Without Land, Noah Opened the Window | Genesis 8-9 (KJV)'; thumbnail line 'THE WATER STOPPED'; swap to B at 48 h if CTR <2%
strategy.evidence: measured: our long CTR 1.92% (range 0.4-3.6%); winners put a question/paradox in the title (Noah Shorts 20.2K views 'Then it rained')
strategy.expected_effect: estimate: +0.5 pt CTR = +25% views at same impressions

strategy.action: keep 1 Bible Short a day (13:30 or 23:30 UTC); Keeper CTA at the emotional peak, one line; cuts from the long carry the Keeper insight
strategy.evidence: measured: 8 Bible Shorts 1,885 views, 26 subs (1.38 per 100 views); 24 older Shorts 3,193 views, 66 subs; best Bible Short 532 views
strategy.expected_effect: estimate: 1.4 subs/100 views x ~300 views/Short = ~4 subs/Short; 2.7 subs/day now
strategy.kill_threshold: <1.5 per Short over 5 Shorts -> change CTA/format
